purpose: Design conventions for a future PingTi new_calib URDF; this file is not an exported robot model or hardware calibration.
arm_joint_units: degrees in LeRobot with use_degrees=true; radians in URDF

bounded_arm_joints.zero_rule: Midpoint of the physical travel recorded during LeRobot calibration. CAD travel is the initial nominal model and must correspond to the same physical endpoints.

wrist_roll.reference_authority: User confirmation: the wrist mechanism was copied from SO ARM and uses the same calibration procedure and physical reference pose.
wrist_roll.zero_rule: Use the same physical reference pose as SO ARM when pressing Enter during calibration, and represent that pose as nominal wrist_roll q=0 in the new URDF.
wrist_roll.quantization_note: The Enter pose is nominally zero; the 2047 versus 2047.5 convention produces a sub-tick angular difference.
wrist_roll.transform_requirement: Align the CAD and URDF frames to the SO ARM physical reference pose. Identical geometry does not mean identical numerical CAD joint angles or origin rpy values.

joint_directions: Match each LeRobot primary motor's positive direction; encode the convention in the new URDF axes and reference transforms.
paired_motors: Shoulder and elbow each remain one mechanical joint in the model; the bridge drives the secondary servo with the mirrored command.

gripper.mapping_requirement: Convert the calibrated opening command to the actual modeled jaw joint angle separately. It is not an arm-joint midpoint convention.

mass_assumptions.authority: User-specified initial modeling assumptions, not measured PingTi properties.
mass_assumptions.printed_material_and_effective_density: Same as the chosen SO ARM reference; calculate PingTi part mass from its own geometry.
mass_assumptions.servo_mass: Same as the chosen SO ARM servo reference, including the STS3250 units as an explicit initial approximation.
mass_assumptions.center_of_mass_and_inertia: Recompute from the PingTi geometry, assigned masses, and component placement; do not copy entire SO ARM link inertial properties.
